identification: Photos show a Victorian mahogany (not cedar; red-brown figured timber, mahogany look) chest of drawers, 2 short over 2 long, turned knobs, rounded top edge, plinth on turned bun feet, c1860-80, pine drawer linings. Scan note of Australian colonial cedar is doubtful; photos read as figured mahogany. Common form with steady but modest demand.

viewing_check: Confirm timber: look at drawer sides and back (cedar smells and has a distinct grain; mahogany veneer on pine is common). Check top for veneer lifting or splits, plinth and feet for repairs, drawers run freely, and measure the width/height (compact 2 over 2 around 95cm wide fits the higher eBay/Armitage comps).
